name: youtube-channel-scraper
title: YouTube Channel Scraper: Stats & Latest Videos
description: Scrape public YouTube channel stats and latest-video summaries from channel URLs, handles, or search keywords. Get names, subscribers, video counts, views, durations, thumbnails, and URLs.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

channel-scraped.eventDescription: Charged once per saved channel (includes channel metadata and any available latest-video rows).
